parameters.query:
SELECT 
    user_id,
    loan_id,
    loan_number,
    loan_type,
    application_type,
    first_name,
    clabe,
    banco,
    beneficiario,
    weekly_payment,
    loan_status,
    coll_segment,
    days_to_due_date,
    payment_number,
    overdue_payments,
      (first_unpaid_due_date::timestamp  AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City') AS first_unpaid_due_date,
    next_due_amount,
    overdue_total_amount,
    overdue_amount,
    due_late_fees,
    total_amount_to_paid,
    monto_campaña,
    total_paid_amount,
    (last_payment_date::timestamp  AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City') AS last_payment_date,
    skip_payments_available,
    skip_fee,
    pending_skip_activation,
    days_to_pay_skip_fee,
    skip_in_last_7_days,
    active_promise,
    days_to_promise,
    (promise_due_date::timestamp  AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City') AS promise_due_date,
    promise_amount,
    descuento,
    monto_descuento,
    total_discount_amount,
    refinanced,
    max_cashback,
    cashback_pool,
    max_cashback_lost_per_payment,
    ever_overdue_payments,
    ever_max_dpd,
    in_coll_agency,
    in_findemo_agency,
    in_external_coll_agency,
    no_rc_answer_3dpd
FROM daily_collections_table
WHERE user_id = '{{ $('Webhook').item.json.user_identifier }}'
--WHERE user_id = 'U-2026018208SGOS9D'
ORDER BY snapshot_date DESC
LIMIT 1;
